description: Alex ACT config-template plugin for the public Microsoft ecosystem — Azure, Fabric (consumption, skills, operations, authoring), Power BI, and M365 Agents Toolkit. Ships a single scaffolding skill (`setup-enterprise-stack`) that generates the `~/.copilot/settings.json` block for the 7 target plugins. Every entry is public and works for any tenant with the corresponding Microsoft subscription. Composes alongside `alex-act-core` (baseline discipline) and `alex-act-illustrator-plugin` (visual authoring). Maintained by Alex_ACT_Steward.

prerequisites.microsoft_tenant: Any tenant with the target Microsoft subscriptions (Azure, Fabric workspace, M365)

verify_install.$comment: Placeholder — will be filled once `setup-enterprise-stack` ships. Pattern from illustrator plugin: scripts/verify-install.mjs runs a filesystem check of installed skill paths.

mall.$comment: Public Mall entry — target marketplace is `alex-mall` (github: fabioc-aloha/Alex_Skill_Mall). No private-tenant dependencies.
